findings.finding: Scope of planning differentiation powers insufficiently explicit.
findings.correction: Added applicable area groups, optional partial-area scope and preservation of remaining area purpose.

findings.finding: Case reference did not identify its actual supporting proposition.
findings.correction: Added Rn. 7 requirement that every main use contribute to area character, without a general weighting formula.

findings.finding: Joint statement about pure office/residential projects could imply mandatory internal use mixture in every building.
findings.correction: Distinguished area purpose from individual building; office building generally permitted under paragraph 2 number 1.

findings.finding: Relevant 4 B 2.25 card assignment was not directly explained in this commentary unit.
findings.correction: Added actual Rn. 8 holding on retail restriction and contribution to urban mixture; preserved undecided Rn. 9–11 surroundings question.

findings.finding: Statement about where parking may occur exceeded statutory rule about admissible parking facilities.
findings.correction: Limited consequence to planning admissibility of parking spaces and garages in designated floors or floor parts.

findings.finding: Compressed account of hydrogen requirements omitted important allocation and measurement details.
findings.correction: Specified existing independent solar plant in GE/GI, allocated and supplementary renewable electricity, aggregate area, mean terrain height reference and multiple-connection restriction for supplementary plants.

findings.finding: Minimum-measure authorization described only as applying to certain measures.
findings.correction: Named included measures and distinguished GRZ, ground area, BMZ and building volume not listed in this authorization.

findings.finding: Building-line obligation could be read as actual duty to develop the land.
findings.correction: Clarified line compliance on development; designation itself does not impose actual construction.

limitations: Selective case-law coverage: the three cited full decisions were reread; no exhaustive new search for every provision.
Historical BauNVO versions are not comprehensively reproduced; concrete old-plan applications require applicable historical primary texts.
No comprehensive commentary on supplementary BauGB rules, Landesbauordnungsrecht or current technical immission rules.
Currentness checked through fresh official consolidation, its amendment statement and the last amendment commencement; no exhaustive review of every gazette issue.
The repeated court request used Firecrawl and a provider-reported same-day cache; earlier direct court requests returned 403.
Fresh-process internal second pass, without external professional approval or a guarantee of all possible interpretations.
review_mode: Independent second pass by a fresh process not involved in first manuscript authorship; no external professional approval
